baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite vocative epithet al-muzzammil is anchored at focus word 2 and directly supports self-wrapping in clothes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is identified through an enclosing bodily state: cloth gathers the body, limits exposure, and makes withdrawal the first visible posture.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping oneself in clothes supplies the literal enclosure and makes protected withdrawal the baseline posture.

changed_reading.before: The address is merely an unexplained personal designation.
changed_reading.after: The address catches the addressee in a concrete state of textile enclosure and bodily withdrawal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus epithet is rooted in z-m-l, whose inventory includes carrying a load or the whole burden.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title can profile capacity or predicament rather than clothing alone: the addressed person is one on whom goods, dependents, or an undivided burden can rest.

activation_trace.role: Carrying a load supplies the burden-bearing image and makes the epithet a possible role-name for a bearer.

changed_reading.before: The epithet describes only what covers the addressee.
changed_reading.after: The epithet may also name what the addressee is already carrying or is fitted to carry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 also reaches the z-m-l branch of a rear rider or a load balanced opposite another on a mount.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressed figure can be imagined relationally: weight is borne through companionship, opposition, or counterbalance rather than by an isolated carrier.

activation_trace.role: Riding behind and counterbalancing on a mount supplies a paired load-system rather than solitary weight.

changed_reading.before: The vocative isolates a single bundled individual.
changed_reading.after: The vocative can retain a latent image of a bearer whose stability depends on a companion or counterweight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A form-distant z-m-l branch at focus word 2 names a weak or negligent person as a burden.
baseline_models.mechanism: The title could initially confront incapacity: the wrapped posture risks becoming the image of someone carried by circumstances rather than carrying a task.

activation_trace.role: The weak person figured as a load supplies an inert counter-reading in which the addressee is burden rather than bearer.

changed_reading.before: Wrapping is a neutral physical circumstance.
changed_reading.after: Wrapping may momentarily expose a vulnerable or hesitant posture that must not harden into identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate imperative turns the cloth-bound title into a threshold: enclosure is the posture from which the addressee is made bodily upright for sustained night practice.

activation_trace.role: Self-wrapping supplies the enclosed starting posture that the next command interrupts.
Bodily standing supplies the opposed upright posture and makes the vocative a summons out of enclosure.
Undertaking a matter at night supplies the temporal vocation into which the rising body enters.

structural_cues: The vocative in 73:1 is followed without narrative delay by the singular imperative in 73:2.
The command assigns the night, rather than public daytime space, as the first arena of changed posture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cloth-enclosure, bodily standing, and night practice; I supply the directional arrow from named state to commanded transformation. The live alternative is that the epithet only records a circumstance before an unrelated command.

changed_reading.before: O wrapped one is a static description of repose.
changed_reading.after: O wrapped one is a transition-address: the enclosed body is named precisely at the moment it must rise into nocturnal work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus load-image becomes proleptic when an utterance is cast onto the addressee as something heavy: title, transfer, verbal object, and weight form one load-bearing event.

activation_trace.role: Carrying a load supplies the focus role that the later heavy utterance fills.
Casting a thing until it is laid down supplies the transfer of the coming burden onto the addressee.
Utterance brought forth in speech identifies the transferred object as articulated saying.
The burden of a load supplies literal heaviness and completes the addressee-as-bearer mechanism.

structural_cues: The future marker in 73:5 makes the heavy saying subsequent to the naming in 73:1.
The prepositional attachment onto you gives the transfer a directed recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a load-bearing title and a later heavy saying cast onto the same addressee; I infer that the earlier epithet anticipates the later office. The alternative is accidental lexical resonance between physical burden and figurative gravity.

changed_reading.before: The title refers to a blanket around the addressee.
changed_reading.after: The title also anticipates the addressee as bearer of a weighty utterance that will be laid upon him.

context_deltas.mechanism: An image of the whole thing gathered in one bundle is answered by ordered arrangement and gathering in recitation: concentrated totality is to be unfolded without losing coherence.

activation_trace.role: The whole thing in its entirety supplies a compact totality latent in the focus epithet.
Consistent ordering and arrangement supplies the method by which a bundled whole is articulated.
Gathering and coming together preserves unity while the whole is voiced in ordered parts.

structural_cues: The doubled r-t-l construction in 73:4 intensifies manner rather than merely commanding output.
The recited object stands between the finite verb and its cognate verbal noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entirety, arrangement, and gathering; I infer a compression-to-articulation process linking the title to recitation. The alternative is that the entirety branch is inactive and only the garment sense is intended.

changed_reading.before: The bundled state is only an obstacle to action.
changed_reading.after: The bundled state can image concentrated wholeness that must be opened into measured, coherently gathered recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterbalanced mount-image becomes a model of sustainable agency: extensive daytime movement does not require solitary control because the affair is entrusted to one who sufficiently carries it.

activation_trace.role: A rear rider or counterbalanced load supplies the focus image of weight stabilized relationally.
Wide scope for movement and livelihood supplies the extended daytime load that needs stabilization.
One who sufficiently manages and preserves an affair supplies the supporting counterpart to the human bearer.

structural_cues: The long daytime movement of 73:7 is followed by the explicit instruction in 73:9 to take a wakil.
The east-west span in 73:9 enlarges the domain over which support is needed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counterbalanced bearing, broad daytime movement, and a sufficient manager; I map delegation onto the counterweight relation. The alternative is that wakil denotes trust without any load-sharing resonance in the title.

changed_reading.before: The wrapped bearer faces the commission alone.
changed_reading.after: The bearer is stabilized by entrusted support; dependence is part of bearing the commission rather than its negation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cloth-enclosure becomes a boundary practice rather than indiscriminate retreat: devotion cuts one relation free, patience restrains reaction, and beautiful separation opens social distance without loss of form.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping in clothes supplies a tangible boundary whose later use can be selective rather than merely defensive.
Cutting and separating supplies the positive release of attention toward the named Lord.
Restraining the self from panic supplies composure so separation does not become reactive flight.
Breaking contact and parting supplies the social boundary drawn against hostile speech.
Beauty in form and action constrains the manner of withdrawal and keeps the boundary ethically shaped.

structural_cues: Both 73:8 and 73:10 intensify separation verbs with cognate verbal nouns.
The modifier beautiful prevents h-j-r from functioning as an unlimited mandate for rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies textile enclosure and two explicitly qualified separations; I infer that the garment image becomes a model for controlled relational boundaries. The alternative is that the clothing and social commands belong to unrelated domains.

changed_reading.before: Wrapping means undifferentiated withdrawal from exposure.
changed_reading.after: Wrapping becomes a disciplined boundary image: attention is freed toward one relation while hostile relations are left with restraint and beauty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reading of the addressee as an intrinsically weak burden loses force because the context relocates immobilization, choking, and injurious heaviness onto the rejecting side; weakness remains only as a starting posture to be reversed.

activation_trace.role: The weak person as a burden supplies the tentative focus model being tested and reduced.
A restraint that prevents movement relocates disabling inertia into the announced punitive scene.
A choking obstruction supplies embodied incapacity on the rejecting side rather than in the commissioned addressee.
Injurious heaviness assigns crushing weight to the seizure of the disobedient and weakens it as the addressee's identity.

structural_cues: The first command after the title is to rise, which treats any inertia as reversible.
The punishment sequence concentrates restraint, choking, and heavy taking among those who reject the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a weak-burden branch and later disabling images aimed elsewhere; I infer contrastive relocation of weakness. The alternative is to discard the weak-person branch entirely as morphologically remote.

changed_reading.before: The title characterizes the addressee as weak, negligent, or burdensome.
changed_reading.after: At most, the title catches a temporary vulnerability that the summons reverses; context places enduring incapacity and crushing weight elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus garment begins a sequence that differentiates covers by function: self-enclosure can be interrupted, concealment can hide truth, the overhead cover can split, and protective covering can preserve a person from an error's effect.

activation_trace.role: Wrapping oneself in cloth supplies the first and human-scale cover in the sequence.
Covering and concealment supplies a morally dangerous cover that differs from mere clothing.
The sky as what rises and shades supplies the immense overhead cover subjected to rupture.
Opening and splitting supplies the failure of even the cosmic covering before the promised event.
A cover that protects and preserves supplies the final beneficial enclosure sought from God.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a human textile cover, later names concealment, depicts the sky splitting, and closes with repeated g-h-f-r forms.
The final protective cover follows an explicit acknowledgment that exact performance cannot be encompassed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four distinct branch-images involving cover, shade, rupture, and protection; I arrange them as a functional contrast. The alternative is that their recurrence is lexical coincidence with no backward pressure on the opening title.

changed_reading.before: The garment in the opening is a private and semantically isolated cover.
changed_reading.after: The opening garment becomes the first cover in a sequence asking which enclosures must be left, which will fail, and which truly protects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The load-bearing title is finally governed by capacity-sensitive measurement: exhaustive accounting fails, practicable recitation is repeated, and impaired movement is acknowledged, so burden-bearing is calibrated rather than maximized.

activation_trace.role: Carrying a load supplies the opening burden whose mode of allocation the closing context revises.
Planning an affair by estimation supplies deliberate calibration of night and day rather than raw accumulation.
Exhaustive numerical accounting supplies the human limit explicitly declared unattainable.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the repeated capacity-sensitive replacement for exact accounting.
Weakening and curtailed movement supplies a concrete bodily reason that uniform load-bearing cannot be required.

structural_cues: The closing ayah revisits standing, fractions of the night, and recitation from the opening command sequence.
The phrase meaning what is practicable is repeated around explicit categories of illness, travel, and fighting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bearer-image, divine estimation, failed exhaustive counting, repeated ease, and bodily limitation; I infer a load-management principle governing the title. The alternative is that the closing adjustment regulates practice without semantically revising the opening epithet.

changed_reading.before: The load-bearer is defined by accepting the maximum possible weight.
changed_reading.after: The load-bearer is one whose serious burden is measured, shared with bodily reality, and reduced to what can actually be carried.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a singular garment epithet does not ordinarily translate as a company. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly contains a traveling-company branch and the context later supplies path-users and an assembled group with the addressee. Downstream prose should present it only as a latent social image in which the singular figure becomes the nucleus or representative of fellow travelers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 carries the z-m-l branch of a traveling company despite the singular vocative form.

activation_trace.role: A traveling company supplies the anomalous collective image latent in the singular focus title.
People of a path and its travelers supply the collective whose route can gather around the addressee.
A group wrapped together supplies the explicit company accompanying the addressed figure.
A community of people supplies the social scale into which the singular commission expands.

changed_reading.before: O wrapped one addresses an entirely private solitary figure.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory social register, the singular wrapped one can be heard as the gathered center of a traveling company that will stand and take a path with him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates an animal-gait branch inside a human vocative. It remains valid as a kinesthetic analogy anchored in the focus root and reinforced by rising, foot placement, and upright alignment in 73:6. Downstream prose must not offer it as a lexical translation; it should be qualified as a bodily image of gathering weight into purposeful forward motion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 2 permits the z-m-l image of an animal bearing down on its forelegs with vigor or speed.

activation_trace.role: Bearing down into an eager gait supplies a dynamic alternative to treating the bundled body as inert.
Approach, rising, and coming forward supplies the onset of nocturnal movement.
The foot pressing its place supplies the gait's grounded contact and embodied force.
Uprightness and balanced alignment supplies controlled form to the forward-bearing motion.

changed_reading.before: The bundled body is motionless beneath its covering.
changed_reading.after: As a contained kinesthetic outlier, the bundled body gathers its weight into a grounded, aligned, forward-bearing night gait.

strongest_changes: The load-bearing branch of the title becomes proleptic for the heavy utterance cast onto the addressee.
The garment state becomes a transition into upright night work and later a model of disciplined rather than absolute separation.
The closing recalibration changes burden-bearing from maximal endurance to measured, practicable carrying that acknowledges bodily limits.
A weaker but coherent cover-sequence distinguishes self-enclosure, concealment, cosmic rupture, and protective forgiveness.
summary.what_was_special: A focus ayah with one rooted word generated several nonexclusive mechanisms: enclosure, load, counterbalance, collective travel, and forward-bearing motion. Context did not select one dictionary sense; it redistributed these images across commission, recitation, reliance, social boundaries, warning, and final ease.
remaining_uncertainties: It is uncertain how strongly any non-garment z-m-l branch would remain audible rather than functioning only as latent activation.
The proleptic heavy-load model is structurally strong, but its backward direction from 73:5 to the opening title is reader-supplied.
The cover taxonomy and singular-company reading are coherent cross-context constructions but should remain explicitly exploratory.
